_comment: Ratchet baseline for scripts/check_merge_domination.py --gate. May shrink, never grow. Regenerate deliberately with --update-baseline when a fix lands or a finding is accepted.
_finding_comment: A merge where one source wins the majority of non-tied merges while carrying an order of magnitude fewer informative distinct values than a contender that never wins. See orion/field/commensurability.py.
